title: Verify review-lens v2 migration is complete and all SPEC tests pass
goal: Confirm that the already-committed review-lens v2 migration satisfies all acceptance criteria by running SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 and fixing any remaining gaps.

steps.description: Run `npm test` (or the targeted review-lens test) to establish which SPEC-1–SPEC-19 assertions pass and which fail. This is the gating step for everything else. Expected: all green. Any failing SPEC identifies the exact gap to fix in subsequent steps.

If SPEC-2 or SPEC-4 fails: verify that `_llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` is present at the rc=0 parse site (~line 330) and that `_review_lens_envelope_schema_ok` validates `.findings | type == "array"`. Fix if missing or incorrect.

If SPEC-1, SPEC-2, SPEC-3, SPEC-13, or SPEC-15 fail: verify `_review_lens_write_result` writes `{result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason}` and is called on every terminal exit path (router failure, unparseable, normalization failure, rc=130, rc=10). Ensure rc=10 writes `disposition:exhausted` and rc=130 writes `disposition:interrupted`. Fix any mis-wired or missing branch.

If SPEC-5 or SPEC-14 fail: verify `_review_lens_budget_guidance` and `_review_lens_wallclock_guidance` are sourced from `_route_resolve_max_turns` / `_route_resolve_timeout` respectively (not hand-copied literals), and their output is appended to the prompt before `route_to_model`. Fix sourcing or call-site if wrong.

If SPEC-7, SPEC-12, SPEC-16, SPEC-17, SPEC-18, or SPEC-19 fail: verify manifest.yaml has `result_contract:2`, `valid_verdicts` (complete + degraded), `primary:true` on the lens_result output, `provides.events` (exactly three), `provides.role:review_lens`, inputs with only `id` + `required` (no path/type/producer_stage), and `hooks.cleanup` absent with an ADR-054 §7 comment. Apply any missing fields.

Confirm two static grep acceptance criteria: (a) `_review_lens_write_result` body contains no hardcoded artifact path literals (no `lens-*.json` or `scope-manifest.md` string literals — SPEC-11); (b) no merge-action coercion tokens (`approve|request_changes|"block"`) appear in plugin.sh or lib/charters.sh (SPEC-9/SPEC-10). Fix any violation found.
Run `npm test` a final time to confirm all SPEC-1–SPEC-19 assertions are green. This satisfies the DoD `npm test green` and `reddens at merge-base` requirements.

notes: The implementation is already fully committed on branch zbuild/issue-1840-ci across multiple prior commits ('Migrate review-lens to contract v2 with schema-gate, budget guidance, and rc=10 exhausted disposition' etc.). Inspection confirmed: manifest.yaml has result_contract:2, valid_verdicts, provides.role:review_lens, provides.events (3 events), primary:true on lens_result, config.router.{timeout_s,max_turns}, inputs with only id+required, hooks.cleanup absent with ADR-054 §7 comment. plugin.sh has _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok schema gate, _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate at line 330, _review_lens_write_result on all exit paths, rc=130 interrupted branch (lines 298-305), rc=10 exhausted branch (lines 307-312), _review_lens_budget_guidance sourced from _route_resolve_max_turns/_route_resolve_timeout, _review_lens_interrupt_handler registered as trap. Test file has SPEC-1 through SPEC-19 covering all acceptance criteria. The plan is therefore primarily a verification plan — implementation steps 2–6 are only executed if the corresponding SPEC fails. The 'before/after golden diff' acceptance criterion is addressed by SPEC-8 (guards advisory degrade behavior is unchanged); no separate golden file in tests/golden/ exists for this plugin. The 'reddens at merge-base' criterion is satisfied structurally: SPEC-1–SPEC-19 assert v2 fields that would be absent on the pre-migration codebase. Estimated_lines is low because no new code is expected; the budget exists only for gap-filling discovered in step-1.
